header.name: Extended Reality in Industry 4.0 (ERI)
header.description: This course aims to introduce extended reality (XR/AR, VR, MR) and its applications in Industry 4.0. It covers various topics that are integral parts of XR technology, for example, haptic technology, 3D modeling, tracking, metaverse and digital twin. The main focus of this course is to enable students to develop their own Anroid/iOS augmented reality (AR) applications. In addition, the students will also get familiar with using Microsoft HoloLens2 AR headset.
prerequisites_desirable: Knowledge of Unity and computer graphics is helpful but not mandatory. It will be good to have programming skills.
Students will require to bring their laptops for in-class practices.
prerequisites_desirable_resolved: Knowledge of Unity and computer graphics is helpful but not mandatory. It will be good to have programming skills.
Students will require to bring their laptops for in-class practices.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to identify the fundamentals of XR technologies. They will develop the understanding about the theory of 3D modeling required for XR and building 3D models of various objects.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students will apply the fundamental knowledge of 3D modeling and XR technologies to develop AR applications with an interactive user interface.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to assess and analyze methods of developing XR applications for Industry 4.0. They will practice hands-on activities to build Android/iOS AR Apps.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to ideate and evaluate the challenges to be addressed using XR technologies in the context of Industry 4.0. They will be able to integrate relevant emerging technologies (i.e., haptics, digital twin, ML) with XR.

lecture_topics: Historical overview, current trends and future applications of extended reality (XR) technologies
types of game engine tools for building XR applications
Introduction to 3D creation, design and modelling theory
importance of 3D modeling processes in XR applications
Basics of 3D modeling software and interface
Introduction to Game Engine tools for building XR applications
importing 3D models to Game Engine platform
User interface elements in the Game Engine
Introduction to tracking for augmented reality (AR)
application of 3D modeling in particle systems
Importance of machine learning in XR
